integrity: The result has a self-contained formal-series proof; exact integer tests are corroboration rather than an infinite certificate. No human or independent evaluation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only Walsh residues modulo four are classified; complete nullities, nonzero magnitudes, higher dyadic layers and odd gcd factors remain undetermined. Historical-priority comparison is bounded, and no independent validation has been performed.
title: A binary-digit parity law and the mod-four Walsh spectrum of Catalan matroid bases
